notes: GATE DECISION: Tier 1 inconclusive -> route to Phase 4 (Tier 2). Rationale: Phase 2's trace showed Logos/cur and Logos/new produce zero lines while every sibling Logos subfolder is explicitly represented, but notmuch 0.40's --debug --verbose output contains no directory-level entry/skip/mtime logging at all (confirmed zero 'mtime' substring matches across the full 1837-line trace), so this evidence cannot discriminate between classification (b) 'directory visited, files silently skipped' and (c) 'directory never entered'. Without knowing which is true, there is no concrete, notmuch-native, evidence-directed fix to attempt -- and the plan explicitly forbids a blind --full-scan retry (already proven ineffective in task 852: notmuch count 65253->65258, +5 unrelated files only, all 22 targets still zero-hit). Per the plan's Rollback/Contingency for conditional index actions, no index-mutating action was taken in this phase. Re-verified sha256 of all 22 files against the Phase 1 baseline (full 22, not a sample): all byte-identical, zero drift, no new mtime/ctime changes beyond the already-disclosed _145 touch from task 852. Routing to Phase 4 (Tier 2 read-only Xapian inspection).
